name: Cooling Fields
description: The Steward's cooling fields: a white plain, steam towers on a grid, and the quietest place in the Enclave system. Everything the Steward thinks, it thinks here. It draws more power than the Enclave does, and in two hundred and eighty-one years of quarterly reconciliations the allocation for this site has never once been queried.

variants.description: The cooling fields, and bolted to the service gate a cast plaque with four hundred and six names on it. Somebody in 2031 filed the Basin payroll as a public document and it has stayed one ever since, which is why the men who poured this ground have names and not a number.
